description: Source file implementing the SystemInfo class and related nested classes for system information management, including network, security, location, device ID, time, and software versioning within the Thunder namespace.

classes.name: SystemInfo
classes.description: Main class providing system information and notification management.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Internet
classes.description: Nested class managing internet connectivity details such as IP address and network type.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Security
classes.description: Nested class managing security-related information like callsign.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Location
classes.description: Nested class providing location details such as timezone, country, region, city, latitude, and longitude.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Id
classes.description: Nested class handling device identifier information.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Time
classes.description: Nested class managing time synchronization data.

methods.name: SystemInfo::SystemInfo
methods.description: Constructor initializing system info with configuration and callback.

methods.name: SystemInfo::RawDeviceId
methods.description: Retrieves raw device MAC address for a given interface.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Update
methods.description: Updates system info and optionally triggers callback.

methods.name: SystemInfo::RecursiveList
methods.description: Recursively calls Updated() on notification clients.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Internet::NetworkType
methods.description: Returns the network type (IPv4, IPv6, or Unknown).

methods.name: SystemInfo::Internet::Set
methods.description: Sets internet info based on provided data.
